_: The build chain past what each record's own note says (TM-7): what a script reads that it did not make, and the places the chain leaves this box. Read by api/tm.py into the offbox mount; every path here is checked to be tracked at HEAD by test_tm7_the_lineage_manifest_names_what_is_there.

autopsy-models.what: Each game's model.json and summary.json, written beside its listing by wasm/listing/tools/autopsy.py and read from a shelf directory by scripts/board-autopsy.py.
autopsy-models.why: They are made from cartridge dumps and kept with them; data/autopsy.json keeps only their shape: addresses, labels, counts and pattern names.

cartridges.what: The cartridge dumps the listings and models are made from.
cartridges.why: Commercial ROMs, kept off every repository (NOTICE.md).
